title: Balassi Bálint összes verse: hálózati kritikai kiadás (network critical edition of the complete poems)
author: Bálint Balassi
institution: Eötvös Loránd University, Budapest (edited by Iván Horváth and Tünde Tóth; published by Gépeskönyv)
notes: Critical edition of Balassi's poems, first published online in 1998 (version 1.0), revised as 1.1 (1999) and 2.0 (2002), with facsimiles, apparatus, notes and a repertory. The site is a set of HTML frames. Newest file seen was modified in 2006. The poems carry no individual dates, so their place within 1450-1700 rests on the author's life span (he died in 1594). Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
